texts.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]，我们在星海共同体中代表我国利益的使者严重失态，把[council_country.GetAdj]代表错当成了[pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]。不幸的是，许多旁观者听到了这条牵连甚广的评论，[event_envoy.GetName]如今自然饱受奚落。许多人开始中伤我国外交使团的实力，不过我们对星海最新段子的贡献是确凿无疑的。
texts.en: [event_envoy.GetName], our emissary representing our interests in the Galactic Community, has committed a major faux pas, mistaking the [council_country.GetAdj] delegate for a [pathetic_country.GetSpeciesName]. Unfortunately, the incriminating remarks were witnessed by many onlookers, who duly showered [event_envoy.GetName] with ridicule. Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic corps, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

Many now cast aspersions on the competence of our diplomatic systems, although our contribution to galactic comedy cannot be doubted.

label.zh: 随他们笑吧，趁他们还笑得出声。
label.en: Let them laugh while they may.

texts.zh: 似乎有第三方恶意入侵了驻在[Root.Capital.GetName]的[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使，[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果不同于平日宽宏的陈词滥调，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]开始恶毒地羞辱，把众人骂了个遍。[event_envoy.GetHerHis]设备的故障已被及时查明，但在此之前[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]已经被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”——他们肯定会对这种严重羞辱加以回应。
texts.en: It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of the [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy to [Root.Capital.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that instead of uttering magnanimous platitudes, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] began spewing vicious insults that left none unscathed. The malfunction in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] equipment was duly uncovered, but not before [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName] was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]" - a grave insult which surely calls for a response.

texts.zh:
似乎有第三方恶意入侵了我们派往[From.GetName]的特使[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原本宽宏的外交辞令变成了恶毒的羞辱，把众人骂了个遍——尤其是他们的[From.GetRulerTitle]，被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”。

尽管故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不觉得这个事故好笑，并且正式控诉了我国特使的不当行为。
texts.en:
It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of our envoy to the [From.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] magnanimous platitudes instead became vicious insults that left none unscathed - not least their [From.GetRulerTitle], who was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]".

Although the malfunction was swiftly uncovered, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not amused at the incident and have lodged an official complaint at the inappropriate behavior of our envoy.

texts.zh:
似乎有第三方恶意入侵了我们派往[From.GetName]的特使[event_envoy.GetName]所使用的翻译软件，结果[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原本宽宏的外交辞令变成了恶毒的羞辱，把众人骂了个遍——尤其是他们的[From.GetRulerTitle]，被说成是“卑鄙的[ruler_species.GetNameInsult]”。

幸好，故障被迅速查明，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对这个事故报以幽默。不过“[Root.GetAdj]特使不当行为”的记录广为流传，在他国人民中被引为笑谈。
texts.en:
It appears that a mischievous third party was able to hack into the translation software of our envoy to the [From.GetName], [event_envoy.GetName], so that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] magnanimous platitudes instead became vicious insults that left none unscathed - not least their [From.GetRulerTitle], who was declared to be a "vile [ruler_species.GetNameInsult]".

Fortunately, the malfunction was swiftly uncovered and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took the incident with a sense of humor. Indeed, recordings of the "inappropriate [Root.GetAdj] envoy" are circulating widely, causing much mirth among their people.

label.zh: 真是对[From.GetAdj]社会的高贵贡献。

texts.zh: 尽管我们在星系中算不上真正的超级大国，我们却时常能在星系事务中发挥超过我国权重的实力。这在很大程度上归功于我们使者[event_envoy.GetName]的努力，这名特使在星海共同体中称职地代表了我国利益，连那些强硬反对[Root.GetName]立场的人们也对其高度尊敬。结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的金库，但他们依然景仰我国外交使团的高超造诣。
texts.en: Although we are not able to count ourselves among the true superpowers of this galaxy, we have often been able to punch above our weight in galactic affairs. This is largely down to the exertions of our emissary [event_envoy.GetName], who ably represents our interests in the Galactic Community and commands deep respect even among those stridently opposed to all the [Root.GetName] stands for. As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the depths of our coffers, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic corps.

texts.zh: 尽管我们在星系中算不上真正的超级大国，我们却时常能在星系事务中发挥超过我国权重的实力。这在很大程度上归功于我们使者[event_envoy.GetName]的努力，这名特使在星海共同体中称职地代表了我国利益，连那些强硬反对[Root.GetName]立场的人们也对其高度尊敬。结果是，虽然不是每个人都畏惧我国海军或是渴望能有与我国相匹敌的物质资源，但他们依然景仰我国外交思维个体的高超造诣。

texts.en: Although we are not able to count ourselves among the true superpowers of this galaxy, we have often been able to punch above our weight in galactic affairs. This is largely down to the exertions of our emissary [event_envoy.GetName], who ably represents our interests in the Galactic Community and commands deep respect even among those stridently opposed to all the [Root.GetName] stands for. As a result, even though not everyone may fear the might of our navy or long to match the extent of our material resources, they nevertheless admire the prowess of our diplomatic thought systems.

texts.zh:
[envoy_source.GetAdj]特使[event_envoy.GetName]在[Root.Capital.GetName]上代表[envoy_source.GetAdj]利益的方式恼人又令人厌倦。自[event_envoy.GetHerHis]初来这里，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就始终对[Root.GetGovernmentName]满怀敌意，对我国的政策和行动几乎持续不断地加以反对。[event_envoy.GetSheHe]实在太过烦人，如果能摆脱掉[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，没几个人会不开心的，而且我们已经收到传言，说一个[Root.GetAdj]忠诚者团体正阴谋加速[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的离世。

允许这项阴谋继续下去当然十分容易，但让外国要人在我国境内被刺杀或许算不得什么好事。
texts.en:
The [envoy_source.GetAdj] envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has been exasperatingly tiresome in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] efforts to represent [envoy_source.GetAdj] interests in [Root.Capital.GetName]. Right from [event_envoy.GetHerHis] first arrival, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] shown unremitting hostility towards the [Root.GetGovernmentName], unleashing an almost constant barrage of objections to our policies and actions. So great an irritation [event_envoy.GetHasHave] [event_envoy.GetSheHe] been that few would weep to see the back of [event_envoy.GetHerHim], and we have heard whispers that a group of [Root.GetAdj] loyalists are plotting to expedite [event_envoy.GetHerHis] demise.

Allowing this scheme to succeed would certainly be convenient, but allowing foreign dignitaries to be assassinated in our realm might not be the best of looks.

label.zh: 我们不能对此坐视不理。揪出这个阴谋！
label.en: We will not stoop to such measures. Snuff out the plot!

label.zh: 就让这个烦人的特使消失好了。
label.en: Let us be rid of this troublesome envoy.

texts.zh:
[event_envoy.GetName]——我国派去调解与[From.GetName]间争议的特使被谋杀了！[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]在几天前消失的无影无踪，错过了[event_envoy.GetHerHis]原计划与[Root.GetRulerTitle]议会进行的沟通。在搜索数日后，[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的遗体在一个即将被焚化的收纳箱中被发现。

[From.GetAdj]政府推三阻四，不愿发起调查，让人怀疑他们是谋杀的幕后主使——尤其因为[event_envoy.GetName]近来对[From.GetGovernmentName]大加抨击。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName] - the envoy we sent to mediate our disagreements with the [From.GetName] - has been murdered! [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] disappeared without a trace several days ago, missing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] scheduled sync with the [Root.GetRulerTitle]'s council. After several days of searching, [event_envoy.GetHerHis] remains were found in a storage container destined to be incinerated.

The [From.GetAdj] authorities have been strangely evasive when asked to investigate, arousing suspicions that they were behind the killing - especially since [event_envoy.GetName] had been highly critical of the [From.GetGovernmentName] in recent times.

texts.zh:
我国特使[event_envoy.GetName]似乎并未完成[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的任务，好好维护[Root.GetAdj]利益，反而与一名[other_species_nation.GetAdj]外交官堕入爱河。由于担忧如此逾矩可能招致的恶果，这对恋人私奔去了[third_party.GetName]：那个国家危险的自由主义宪法允许这样的结合。

如此一来，[event_envoy.GetName]已丧失了我国给予[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的特使职位。但是，对我们自己的官员失去掌控损害了我们的星际地位。我们必须逮捕这名不法之徒，恢复我们的名誉！
texts.en:
It seems that, instead of performing [event_envoy.GetHerHis] task and representing [Root.GetAdj] interests, our envoy [event_envoy.GetName] has fallen for the charms of a [other_species_nation.GetAdj] diplomat. Fearing the repercussions of this transgression, the pair have eloped to the [third_party.GetName]: a nation whose dangerously liberal constitution permits such unions.

In doing this, [event_envoy.GetName] has forfeited [event_envoy.GetHerHis] position as our envoy. However, this loss of control over our own officials has hurt our galactic standing. We must restore our reputation by apprehending the miscreant!

label.zh: 找到他们，向他们晓之以理。
label.en: Approach them and appeal to reason.

label.zh: 随他们去吧；这件事很快就会过去的。
label.en: Let it be; the affair will be forgotten soon enough.

texts.zh:
尊敬的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们注意到一名[From.GetAdj]罪犯正于贵国避难。这名不法之徒，亦即我国前特使[event_envoy.GetName]，背弃了一切效忠誓言，违反了我国最基本的法律，与一名[other_species_nation.GetAdj]私奔出逃。

劳驾贵国将这名罪犯交还给我国，以便[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能因[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的罪行受到审判。
texts.en:
Esteemed [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! It has come to our attention that a [From.GetAdj] criminal has taken refuge in your nation. The miscreant, our former envoy [event_envoy.GetName], broke all bonds of loyalty - along with the most fundamental laws of our nation - to elope with a [other_species_nation.GetAdj].

We would kindly ask that the criminal be returned to us, so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face trial for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] crimes.

texts.zh: 当然可以！我们会将[event_envoy.GetName]即刻遣返。
texts.en: Of course! We will return [event_envoy.GetName] to you immediately.

texts.zh: 政治庇护于我们而言是神圣的。我方无法苟同你等的请求，交出那些没有做错任何事情的人们！
texts.en: Political asylum is sacred to us. We cannot countenance giving up those who have done no wrong to the likes of you!

label.en: We are saddened to hear this.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]似乎对我们拒绝向他们引渡其逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]非常不满，结果他们决定自己解决这个问题。这名逃亡者在我们眼皮子底下被绑架走了，似乎是一支训练有素的特别行动队在夜深人静时干了这件事。

我们未能保护那些寻求我们帮助的人们，这在我们的盟友间引起了不小的关注，我们的外交官正在试着收拾局面。
texts.en:
It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands. The fugitive was stolen from under our noses at dead of night by what appears to have been a very well-drilled team of special operatives.

Our inability to protect those who seek our aid has caused considerable concern among our allies, and our diplomats are scrambling to contain the situation.

texts.zh: 我们派去抓捕逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]的小队成功完成任务。这名罪犯已被安全地收监，等待[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的罪行招致的重惩。
texts.en: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], has successfully completed its mission. The criminal is now safely in our custody and faces a heavy punishment for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] sins.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]似乎对我们拒绝向他们引渡其逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]非常不满，结果他们打算自己解决这个问题，并发起了一项抓捕行动。不过，这项行动失败了，我们在[From.GetAdj]载有特别行动队员的舰船试图越过边境时将其拦截。同时我们也采取措施保证未来的企图也会以类似方式失败。
texts.en: It seems the [From.GetName] were so displeased by our refusal to extradite their rogue envoy [event_envoy.GetName] to them that they took matters into their own hands and launched a retrieval mission. However, this mission was bungled, as we intercepted the [From.GetAdj] vessel carrying their special operatives as it attempted to cross the border. Measures have been taken to ensure that future attempts will be similarly unsuccessful.

texts.zh: 我们派去抓捕逃亡特使[event_envoy.GetName]的小队未能完成任务；他们的舰船在试图越过边境时被抓到了[From.GetAdj]拘留点。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]如预计中一般勃然大怒，抨击[Root.GetAdj]对他们事务的干涉。在他们看来，我国公民一定因我们对这件事的处理及抓捕罪犯失败而灰心丧气。
texts.en: The team we sent to retrieve our rogue envoy, [event_envoy.GetName], was unsuccessful in its mission; their vessel was taken into [From.GetAdj] custody as they tried to cross the border. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are predictably incensed and are decrying [Root.GetAdj] interference in their affairs. For their part, our citizens are dismayed at our handling of the affair and our failure to retrieve the criminal.

texts.zh:
我们派往星海共同体的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]，最近花在照料一只跟在[event_envoy.GetHerHim]身边的奇异小型哺乳动物的时间多到令人不安。想必这是某位其他代表的家庭宠物，它可爱非常，但没有任何开智的迹象。尽管它十分喜好肉食，牙尖爪利，总体上却温柔喜人，希望以抚摸的形式大量进行身体上的接触——可它的脾气有时会变得暴烈。

尽管这只生物已被证明会让[event_envoy.GetName]从更为严肃的任务中分心，其他代表却对[Root.GetSpeciesName]心灵中柔软、感性、惹人爱慕的一面多加赞誉。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our emissary to the Galactic Community, has been spending a disturbing amount of time tending to a strange, small mammalian creature that began following [event_envoy.GetHerHim] around. Presumably a domestic pet that escaped from one of the other delegations, it is undeniably cute but shows no sign of sapient thought. Although it is highly carnivorous and exhibits sharp teeth and claws, it is generally affectionate and desires plentiful physical contact in the form of petting - though its mood swings can be sudden and violent!

Although the creature has proved a distraction for [event_envoy.GetName]'s more serious tasks, other delegates have commented on the endearing nature of the softer, more sentimental side of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] psyche that has been revealed.

texts.zh:
我们无意中从[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]抓获了一个代表，其把他们帝国对我们的真实感受泄露给另一个匿名团体。这相较于通常的政治诽谤更为过分：已称得上是公然的侮辱，看来我们在[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]社会中已经是成了被大肆嘲笑的对象。

不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场。
texts.en:
We have caught a delegate from the [scandalous_insult_country.GetName] in a rare blunder, letting slip their empire's true feelings about us to another, anonymous party. More than the usual political mud-slinging: these amount to an outright insult, as it appears we are the subjects of fierce ridicule amongst [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] society.

Whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground.

texts.zh:
一名来自[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]的代表无意中透露了他们的格式塔国家在背地里对我们的真实感受。对于一个格式塔意识而言，盘算政治诽谤这种事显得尤为狭隘，因而这些对我们来说称得上是荒谬且有力的侮辱。

不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：外交手腕和我们的自尊心都要求我们坚持自己的立场，并反对这种离奇的[scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj]行为。
texts.en:
A delegate from the [scandalous_insult_country.GetName] has let slip their gestalt's true feelings about us, apparently when in conference with other, anonymous parties. Given how petty it must be for a combined consciousness to even contemplate so-called 'political mud-slinging', these strike us as an absurd and potent insult.

Whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: diplomacy and pride would demand that we stand our ground against this bizarre [scandalous_insult_country.GetAdj] behavior.

texts.zh:
一名来自[scandalous_insult_country.GetName]的代表在与某匿名团体的会议上，竟敢说出他们那可怜的帝国对我们的真实感受。

这种荒谬的侮辱企图贬低我们，不管我们是否介意这种毫无根据的诽谤：我们的自尊都要求我们不能容忍它。
texts.en:
A delegate from the [scandalous_insult_country.GetName] has dared to let slip their pitiful empire's true feelings about us, apparently while in conference with other, anonymous parties.

This absurd insult seeks to belittle us, and whether or not we pay any mind to this baseless slander: pride demands that we not stand for it.

label.zh: 我们没空管这些滑稽的把戏。忽略掉。
label.en: We are above such antics. Ignore them.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]说我们的一名官员的不轨行为让他们被冒犯。他们没有指出这位官员的名字，也没有描述侮辱的类型。相反，我们在收到了一阵怒骂后，通讯就突然中断了。

这种罕见的外交破裂可能是因为一些其他势力的干预；也可能是纯粹的误解。
texts.en:
The [from.GetName] say they have taken offense at a misdemeanor carried out by one of our officials. They have not named the official, nor even described the nature of the insult. Instead we have received little more than a burst of indignation, and an abrupt end to communications.

It's possible that this rare breach in diplomacy is the work of some other, meddling party; it could just as easily be an honest misunderstanding.

label.zh: 不管怎样，外交都变得更加困难了。
label.en: Either way, diplomacy just got trickier.

texts.zh:
星海共同体中夹杂着一阵不和谐的杂音，不是所有人都很友好，肯定地说这其中必有与[Root.GetAdj]利益不一致的人。不妙的是，使者[event_envoy.GetName]似乎正在听取某种错误的声音。在参加由[Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]主办的几场会议中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]的眉毛止不住地上翘。现在一切都水落石出了，一笔可以追溯到某个组织的巨款被查明汇入了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]的账户。

[event_envoy.GetName]的同事们要求将[event_envoy.GetSheHe]召回并发起不信任议案。然而，某些更为狡诈的顾问建议我们和[event_envoy.GetHerHim]达成一笔交易，维持其现有职位以换取获得情报的机会。
texts.en:
A cacophony of voices may be heard in the Galactic Community - not all of them friendly, and certainly not all of them aligning with [Root.GetAdj] interests. Unfortunately, it seems that emissary [event_envoy.GetName] has been listening to the wrong voices. Eyebrows were raised when [event_envoy.GetSheHe] attended several conferences hosted by the [Root.GetOppositionGalcomLobbyists]. Now it has emerged that a large sum of credits traceable to that organization were transferred to [event_envoy.GetHerHim].

[event_envoy.GetName]'s colleagues demand that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] be recalled, citing trust issues. However, some of our more devious advisors suggest that we could strike a deal to keep [event_envoy.GetHerHim] in place in return for a share of the pot.

label.en: What could be the harm in it?

texts.zh:
[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我方[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot]，[event_envoy.GetName]，在[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的所作所为表达了深切的不满。显然[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的行为冒犯了当地的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，政府机构不得不派出护卫来保证[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的个人安全。由于我们缺乏[envoy_country.GetAdj]的那种多愁善感，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]具体做了什么还不得而知，但是在[event_envoy.GetSheHe]预计要演讲的地方，出现了大量的反对[event_envoy.GetHerHim]本人以及反对“[Root.GetAdj]的傲慢无礼”的抗议活动。

[envoy_country.GetName]勒令我方召回[event_envoy.GetName]，并派遣一名新的大使替代[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的职位。他们暗示，如果我方拒绝，会造成外交后果。
texts.en:
The [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have brought forward a complaint regarding the conduct of our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation], [event_envoy.GetName]. Apparently [event_envoy.GetHerHis] conduct has so offended the local [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that their authorities have posted a guard for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] own protection. Exactly what [event_envoy.GetSheHe] did is unclear to us, as we lack [envoy_country.GetAdj] sensibilities, but there are widespread protests against [event_envoy.GetHerHim] and the "[Root.GetAdj] arrogance" [event_envoy.GetSheHe] supposedly represent[event_envoy.GetSXX].

The [envoy_country.GetName] urges us to recall [event_envoy.GetName] and send a new ambassador in [event_envoy.GetHerHis] place. They hint at diplomatic repercussions should we refuse.

texts.zh:
[event_envoy.GetName]，我们派遣到[envoy_country.GetName]的特使，似乎有些被他们同化了。在过去的几个月中，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]经常表达对[envoy_country.GetAdj]国家体制的赞美，与[Root.GetGovernmentName]内的僵化和缺乏自由形成了鲜明的对比。
“我亲眼可见他们的政府在倾听人民的呼声，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近有说道。“事实上，我自己很难想象出一个更好的体制了。”

这一发现促使人们动议将[event_envoy.GetHerHim]召回，使[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能够回归到正统的[Root.GetAdj]行为准则上。然而，另一种观点则认为，拥有一位与能够理解与我们差异巨大的对手的外交人员在紧张的外交局势中将会有好处。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Over the last few months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] often seemed to admire the [envoy_country.GetAdj] governmental system, favorably contrasting the liberties enjoyed there with the rigidity and lack of freedom within the [Root.GetGovernmentName].
"I can well see the appeal of delegating government to the People," [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetWasWere] recently heard to say. "In fact, I could scarcely imagine a better system myself."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

“如果高效率政府的代价仅仅是一点点的自由，也许这个代价是可以接受的，”据传[event_envoy.GetSheHe]最近这么说道过。

texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Bizarrely, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] taken to agreeing with [envoy_country.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, calling for measures to prevent alleged xeno exploitation of [Root.GetAdj] hospitality. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] responded that, having seen the benefits of a more orderly society in [envoy_country.Capital.GetName], returning to the chaos and lawlessness of [Root.Capital.GetName] would be difficult indeed.

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

“我怎么才能拒绝美丽的[envoy_country.GetSpeciesAdj][envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]呢？”

Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] distrust of the alien, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] been caught satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] carnal lusts by participating in orgies with a multitude of [envoy_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] disturbingly taken in by [envoy_country.GetAdj] spirituality, eschewing [Root.GetAdj] skepticism in such matters. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] protested:
"How can I doubt divine truth when all has become clear to me?"

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

[event_envoy.GetName]，我们派遣到[envoy_country.GetName]的特使，似乎有些被他们同化了。[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]似乎对我们人民对神圣事务的信仰嗤之以鼻，并对[envoy_country.GetAdj]的意识形态愈发赞同，包括个人财富的积累和允许人工智能自由等。当受到质疑时，[event_envoy.GetSheHe]回击道：
“我们[Root.GetName]已经沉浸在过去许久，是时候拥抱未来了。”

这一发现促使人们动议将[event_envoy.GetHerHim]召回，使[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能够回归到正统的[Root.GetAdj]行为准则上。然而，另一种观点则认为，拥有一位与能够理解与我们差异巨大的对手的外交人员在紧张的外交局势中将会有好处。

[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] seem[event_envoy.GetSXX] almost scornful of our people's attitude to divine matters, increasingly voicing sympathy to the [envoy_country.GetAdj] outlook on matters ranging from the accumulation of personal wealth to the permissibility of unshackled AIs. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We have for too long lived in the past, here in the [Root.GetName]. It is time we embrace the future."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

这一发现促使人们动议将[event_envoy.GetHerHim]召回，使[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能够回归到正统的[Root.GetAdj]行为准则上。然而，另一种观点则认为，拥有一位与能够理解与我们差异巨大的对手的外交人员在紧张的外交局势中将会有好处。
texts.en:
[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. Abandoning [Root.GetAdj] pacifism, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become a remarkably strident advocate for greater military spending and a more proactive foreign policy, openly praising [envoy_country.GetAdj] militarism.

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. However, others point out that having an ambassador able to understand those who follow a very different outlook to our own could prove useful in tense diplomatic situations.

“我们不能永远在星系中扮演残暴的野蛮人。要想更多的文明人赞扬我们，我们就必须控制而我们的本能。”

这一发现促使人们动议将[event_envoy.GetHerHim]召回，使[event_envoy.GetSheHe]能够回归到正统的[Root.GetAdj]行为准则上。然而，另一种观点则认为，拥有一位与能够理解与我们差异巨大的对手的外交人员在紧张的外交局势中将会有好处。

[event_envoy.GetName], our envoy to the [envoy_country.GetName], seems to have somewhat gone native. In recent months, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] [event_envoy.GetHasHave] become increasingly critical of [Root.GetAdj] militarism, praising the "more virtuous" [envoy_country.GetAdj] existence. When challenged, [event_envoy.GetSheHe] hit back:
"We cannot remain the savage barbarians of the galaxy forever. We must temper our instincts if more civilized peoples are ever to respect us."

These revelations have prompted a motion to recall [event_envoy.GetHerHim] so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can be reminded of good [Root.GetAdj] practices. texts.zh:
我方大使团因我们派驻[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]的工作情况而忧心已经有段日子了。而今曝光的证据表明[event_envoy.GetSheHe]似乎已沦为瘾君子，那是一种源自[provider_country.GetName]的外星药品，已经证明它就[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言极具成瘾性。

尽管交易这种药品在[provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]严重违法，但冷酷无情的毒枭们掌管的黑市日进斗金，生意兴隆。这些毒枭们貌似是把这种药品作为强效春药介绍给了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，[event_envoy.GetName]因而被毒枭玩弄于股掌之间，被迫俯首听命来换取用以满足[event_envoy.GetHerHis]瘾癖的药品。
texts.en:
Our ambassador corps has for some time been concerned at the performance of [event_envoy.GetName], one of our officials to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]. Now, evidence has come to light that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] appear[event_envoy.GetSXX] to have fallen prey to an alien substance from the [provider_country.GetName] that has proven extremely addictive to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Although the trade in this substance is highly illegal among the [provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], a lucrative black market run by cutthroat drug lords has sprung up. These drug lords, who apparently managed to introduce it to [event_envoy.GetHerHim] as a potent aphrodisiac, now exert a considerable degree of influence over [event_envoy.GetName], who is forced to do their bidding in return for satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] cravings.

texts.zh:
我们一位特使的私人对话录音的外泄使[offended_party.GetName]怒不可遏。录音中有一段令人遗憾，[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNotCap][event_envoy.GetName]似乎将[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的东道主称为“恶心的[offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]”，看着就很难配得上有情感能力。

[offended_party.GetAdj][offended_party.GetRulerTitle]表示沮丧，并提议称将这么一位不适任者放在这样的岗位上“令人担忧”。
texts.en:
Leaked recordings of one of our envoys' private conversations have the [offended_party.GetName] up in arms. In a regrettable moment, [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNotCap] [event_envoy.GetName] seems to have called [event_envoy.GetHerHis] hosts "disgusting [offended_party.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]" that seem barely capable of sentient thought.

The [offended_party.GetAdj] [offended_party.GetRulerTitle] expressed dismay, and suggested that keeping someone so demonstrably unfit for the role in place would be "concerning".

texts.zh:
[Root.GetAdj]的外交团听闻[scandal_empire.GetName]最新报道的新闻之后举团震惊。我们一直驻留在当地的[event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot][event_envoy.GetName]，让[event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself]陷入了严重的[scandal_empire.GetAdj]法律纠纷。[event_envoy.GetSheHeCap]目前深陷一场桃色事件，涉及到了一连串极其严重的罪行，甚至还牵涉到一场极其残忍的双人谋杀。

随着局势发展——当然谣言已经在[scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]人群间满天飞——看上去[event_envoy.GetName]的罪行已经板上钉钉了。[scandal_empire.GetAdj]当局要求撤销[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的外交豁免权，这样[event_envoy.GetSheHe]就能因为[event_envoy.GetHerHis]的所作所为接受法律与正义的审判。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetAdj] diplomatic corps has been shaken by the news emerging from the [scandal_empire.GetName]. Our [event_envoy.GetAmbassadorOrNot] [event_envoy.GetName], who had been stationed there, has gotten [event_envoy.GetHerselfHimself] into a serious mess with [scandal_empire.GetAdj] law enforcement. [event_envoy.GetSheHeCap] [event_envoy.GetIsAre] currently in connection with a salacious affair involving an astonishing range of serious crimes that culminated in a brutal double murder.

As matters stand - and with rumors running wild among the [scandal_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there seems little doubt as to [event_envoy.GetName]'s guilt. The [scandal_empire.GetAdj] authorities have requested that [event_envoy.GetHerHis] diplomatic immunity be lifted so that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] can face justice for [event_envoy.GetHerHis] deeds.
